usage.text:
Usage: ot [options] Commands: daemon Start the OTheater daemon in this terminal backup Make a backup of the data now restore Put a backup back (the daemon must be stopped) directives [...] Orders (the daemon must be stopped); actions: list, show , add , extend , suspend --scenario [text], revoke --reason chat Talk to the Director of a repository (the daemon must be running) tui Open the terminal interface (the daemon must be running) profile [...] Accounts of the clients (the daemon must be stopped); actions: add , list, drain /, remove /, exec / [-- ] (also with the daemon running), shims sync, shims path [--install|--uninstall] (the commands by profile) executor [...] Executors of the models (the daemon must be stopped); actions: models , add , list, check [id], remove plugin [...] Plugins (work with the daemon stopped or running); actions: install , list, update [], remove , enable --project

, disable --project

, secret set [--project

] (origin: a folder, npm:@ or git:#) api rotate-token Swap the API token (works with the daemon stopped or running) trajectory export Write the ATIF trajectory of a play to a file (works with the daemon stopped or running) analysis The analysis of the system: times, waits, cost and coverage over the daily aggregates (works with the daemon stopped or running) service The logon service of the daemon: install, uninstall, status, start, stop (works with the daemon stopped or running) uninstall [--purge-data] Remove the logon service and keep the data (--purge-data also deletes it, after asking) init [--no-tui] First setup with no questions: install the logon service, start the daemon, look for the commands of the Executors (it shows the clients that are missing, with the npm command, and installs the ACP adapters as clients.adapters.install says) and open the terminal interface adapters [...] The ACP adapters OTheater installs for Claude Code and Codex (work with the daemon stopped or running); actions: status, install [claude-code|codex] vault The vault of the secrets (adapters.vault; works with the daemon stopped or running); actions: status, use Options: --data-dir

Data directory (default: OT_DATA_DIR, else the user data folder) --non-interactive Ask nothing on the terminal (the service and the daemon OTheater starts use it; a locked vault stays locked) -h, --help Show this help -v, --version Show the version Options of "ot directives": --scenario Local order for this scenario (without it, add makes a global one) --kind instruction (default), rule or suspension --role Only for this role (repeat it for more roles) --rule-key --rule-value The configuration key a rule overrides, and its value --suspends The global order a suspension takes out of the scenario --replaces Revoke this order and put the new one in its place --from --until --for Validity (YYYY-MM-DD [HH:mm]; 30m, 2h, 3d) --forever extend: take the end away --reason revoke: why --all list: also expired and revoked orders Options of "ot chat": --repo The repository (default: the current folder) --base The branch plays start from and deliver to (default: main) --name A name for the scenario (default: the folder name; a chat is identified by it) --type project (default, needs a repository) or chat (a generic chat, no repository) --new-project Create the project in --repo (a folder that does not exist or is empty) with the structure of the software profile Options of "ot profile": --kind add: token_plan (default, a subscription) or api (a key) --provider

add: the provider of the account (default: anthropic for claude-code, openai for codex) --api-key-env add --kind api: the NAME of the environment variable that holds the key (never type the key as an argument) --api-key-stdin add --kind api: read the key from the first line of the standard input --accept-notice add: go on after the notice about a second subscription account of the same provider --login add: log in to the new subscription account right away (like profiles.add.login: auto; needs a terminal) --no-login add: do not log in now, whatever profiles.add.login says (ask, the default, asks in a terminal; auto logs in; off does not offer it) --client list: only this client --all list: also the removed profiles --check-login list: ask each client whether the profile has a login --json Print JSON instead of text exec runs the client's own CLI inside the profile, in this terminal. The common words login, logout, status, run and --model (and those of profiles.commands and profiles.options) become the client's own; after "--" the arguments go as they are. shims sync writes one command per profile (codex-personal) in the bin folder of the data; shims path says how to put that folder in PATH: --install / --uninstall shims path: write or take out the line in the rc file of the shell (asks first) --shell shims path: zsh, bash or fish (default: the one of SHELL) -y, --yes shims path --install: do not ask Options of "ot executor": --effort add: low, medium or high (default: what the catalog suggests) --family add: the family (provider) of a model whose catalog gives none --as add: the name of the model inside the Executor id (default: derived) --local-url add: URL of the local model server (default: the one in the catalog) --local-server add: llama-cpp (default) or ollama --role [:] add: also put it in this role, at position n (repeat it for more roles) --test-session add: run the short test session (it calls the model); --no-test-session skips it --dry-run add: report the fields and the checks, write nothing --profile list: only the Executors of this profile --all list: also the removed ones Options of "ot plugin": --project

enable, disable: the project; list: only the plugins that project has; secret set: the value is only for that project -y, --yes enable: do not ask (what the plugin asks for is printed all the same) --json Print JSON instead of text secret set reads the value from the standard input (hidden in a terminal) and never prints it. install and update never turn a plugin on, and run no script of the package or of the repository. A plugin whose plugin.yaml changed stays off in every project until "enable" approves it again. Options of "ot analysis": --from --to The period, YYYY-MM-DD (default: analysis.report.default_days days up to the last day ready) --group-by day (default), scenario, executor or role --scenario Only this scenario --compare-from --compare-to Compare with this other period --compare-scenario Compare with this other scenario over the same days (needs --scenario) --json Print the report as JSON Options of "ot trajectory": --unit play (one file, the attempts embedded), attempt (one file per attempt) or play_files (the play and one file per attempt); default: atif.export.unit (with the daemon running, only play) --content full (default: atif.export.content; the secrets are masked all the same) or redacted (no text) --out

The folder of the files (default: atif.export.dir, "trajectories" in the data folder) Options of "ot service" and "ot uninstall": --no-start service install: do not start the daemon now --json service status: print JSON instead of text --purge-data uninstall: also delete the whole data folder (asks first; it cannot be undone; the keyring is not touched) -y, --yes uninstall --purge-data: do not ask The service is the user's own and runs only while the user is logged on. The service.* keys of the configuration (restart, autostart, console) are read at the install. "ot tui" starts the daemon when none is running (tui.start_daemon). Options of "ot adapters": --json status: print JSON instead of text install downloads the pinned version from the npm registry (clients.adapters.registry), checks its sha512 and puts it in the data folder: no sudo, no change to PATH. It never installs the official client. Options of "ot vault": --json status: print JSON instead of text use changes only adapters.vault in config.yaml (the comments stay) and moves no secret. Options of "ot init": --no-tui do the steps up to the commands and exit, without opening the interface (for scripts) In the chat, "/attach " attaches a file (copied; "/attach --ref " keeps it in place): the next message you send names it as A for the Director. Without a command, "ot" opens the terminal interface when the input and the output are a terminal (ui.bare_command: tui, the default); with ui.bare_command: help, or without a terminal, it shows this help. Exit codes: 0 success, 1 the command failed, 2 wrong usage.
usage.missingBackupPath: "ot restore" needs the backup folder to restore.
usage.noInput: "ot chat" needs a place to read the messages from.
usage.tuiNeedsTerminal: "ot tui" needs a terminal: the input and the output must be a terminal.
usage.tuiNotBuilt: The terminal interface is not built: run "pnpm build" (missing: {{file}}).
usage.missingDirectivesAction: "ot directives" needs an action: list, show, add, extend, suspend or revoke.
usage.directiveNeedsId: This action needs the order id (for example O1).
usage.directiveNeedsText: "ot directives add" needs the text of the order.
usage.directiveNeedsScenario: "ot directives suspend" needs --scenario <id>: the scenario that stops following the order.
usage.directiveKind: --kind must be instruction, rule or suspension.
usage.directiveTooMany: Too many arguments for this action of "ot directives".
usage.missingProfileAction: "ot profile" needs an action: add, list, drain, remove or exec.
usage.profileTooMany: Too many arguments for this action of "ot profile".
usage.profileNeedsClientName: "ot profile add" needs the client and the profile name (for example: claude-code work).
usage.profileNeedsProvider: "ot profile add" needs --provider <provider> for this client.
usage.profileApiNeedsKey: An API profile needs the key: --api-key-env <NAME> or --api-key-stdin.
usage.profileLoginJson: --login cannot go with --json: the login of the client is text for a terminal.
usage.profileNoInput: "ot profile add --api-key-stdin" needs a place to read the key from.
usage.profileNeedsId: This action needs the profile id (<client>/<name>, for example claude-code/work).
usage.missingExecutorAction: "ot executor" needs an action: models, add, list, check or remove.
usage.executorTooMany: Too many arguments for this action of "ot executor".
usage.executorNeedsProfile: "ot executor models" needs the profile id (<client>/<name>, for example opencode/local).
usage.executorNeedsModel: "ot executor add" needs the profile id and the model (for example: opencode/local minimax/MiniMax-M2).
usage.executorNeedsId: This action needs the Executor id (<model>-<effort>@<client>/<profile>).
usage.profileExecId: "{{id}}" is not a profile id (<client>/<name>, for example codex/personal).
usage.profileExecMissingValue: The common option --{{name}} needs a value.
usage.profileExecNotForClient: "{{word}}" is a common word that {{client}} has no translation for. Its common commands: {{commands}}; its common options: {{options}}. To give the word to the client as it is, put it after "--".
usage.missingShimsAction: "ot profile shims" needs an action: sync or path.
usage.unknownShimsAction: Unknown action "{{action}}" for "ot profile shims" (sync or path).
usage.shimsPathOnly: --install, --uninstall and --shell are options of "ot profile shims path".
usage.shimsNeedShell: Could not tell the shell from SHELL; say which with --shell ({{shells}}).
usage.missingTrajectoryAction: Missing action for "ot trajectory". Use: export <play>.
usage.unknownTrajectoryAction: Unknown action for "ot trajectory": {{action}}. Use: export <play>.
usage.trajectoryNeedsPlay: "ot trajectory {{action}}" needs the id of a play.
usage.trajectoryTooMany: "ot trajectory export" takes only one play.
usage.analysisDay: {{flag}} must be a day written YYYY-MM-DD.
usage.missingServiceAction: Missing action for "ot service". Use install, uninstall, status, start or stop.
usage.unknownServiceAction: Unknown action "{{action}}" for "ot service". Use install, uninstall, status, start or stop.
usage.analysisCompareOne: Compare two periods (--compare-from, --compare-to) or two scenarios (--compare-scenario), not both.
usage.missingPluginAction: "ot plugin" needs an action: install, list, update, remove, enable, disable or secret.
usage.pluginTooMany: Too many arguments for this action of "ot plugin".
usage.pluginNeedsOrigin: "ot plugin install" needs the origin: a folder, npm:<package>@<version> or git:<url>#<ref>.
usage.pluginNeedsId: This action of "ot plugin" needs the plugin id.
usage.pluginNeedsProject: "ot plugin enable" and "ot plugin disable" need --project <project>.
usage.pluginSecretUsage: Usage: ot plugin secret set <id> <NAME> [--project <project>] (the value is read from the standard input).
usage.pluginSecretName: The name of a secret has uppercase letters, digits and "_", and starts with a letter.
usage.pluginSecretNoInput: "ot plugin secret set" reads the value from the standard input: pipe it in or use a terminal.
usage.missingAdaptersAction: Missing action for "ot adapters". Use status or install.
usage.unknownAdaptersAction: Unknown action "{{action}}" for "ot adapters". Use status or install.
usage.unknownAdaptersClient: Unknown client "{{client}}" for "ot adapters". Use claude-code or codex.
usage.missingVaultAction: Missing action for "ot vault". Use status or use.
usage.unknownVaultAction: Unknown action "{{action}}" for "ot vault". Use status or use.
usage.missingVaultMode: Missing vault for "ot vault use". Use keyring, encrypted-file or auto.
usage.unknownVaultMode: Unknown vault "{{mode}}" for "ot vault use". Use keyring, encrypted-file or auto.

daemon.running: OTheater daemon running (pid {{pid}}), data in {{dataDir}}. Press Ctrl+C to stop.
daemon.vaultLocked: The vault is locked: no master password was given, so secrets are not available.

backup.daemonRunning: The daemon is running on this data directory: the copy is made from the database file and no event is recorded.

restore.daemonRunning: The daemon is running on this data directory. Stop it before restoring.
restore.keptDatabase: The previous database was kept as {{path}}.
restore.keptScenarios: The previous scenarios folder was kept as {{path}}.
restore.daemonIdRestored: The daemon id of the backup was restored.
restore.keptDaemonId: The previous daemon id file was kept as {{path}}.
restore.telemetryRestored: The telemetry file of the backup was restored.
restore.keptTelemetry: The previous telemetry file was kept as {{path}}.

api.rotatedOffline: New API token written to the api-token file. The daemon is stopped, so it will be used at the next start.
api.rotated: API token swapped. The old token no longer works; the new one is in the api-token file.
api.noApi: The daemon is running on this data directory, but its API is off or its api.json is stale. Check "ot daemon" and try again.
api.noToken: The api-token file is missing or cannot be read, so the daemon cannot be asked to swap it.
api.unreachable: Could not reach the daemon API at {{url}}.
api.rejected: The daemon refused the request (HTTP {{status}}). The api-token file may be old: check that it belongs to this daemon.
api.failed: The daemon could not swap the token (HTTP {{status}}).

trajectory.needsStoppedDaemon: The daemon is running on this data directory: only the unit "play" (one file with every attempt embedded) can be exported now. Stop the daemon for "attempt" or "play_files".
trajectory.noToken: The api-token file is missing or cannot be read, so the daemon cannot be asked for the trajectory.
trajectory.failedOnline: The daemon could not give the trajectory (HTTP {{status}}).

analysis.title: Analysis from {{from}} to {{to}} ({{scenario}})
analysis.ready: Aggregates ready through: {{through}}. Days of the period without aggregates: {{missing}}.
analysis.tokens: Tokens: input {{input}}, output {{output}}, cached {{cached}} ("n/a" is a gap, not zero)
analysis.cost: Cost: real {{real}}, API-equivalent {{equivalent}}; per approved demand: real {{perDemand}}, API-equivalent {{perDemandEquivalent}}
analysis.coverage: Coverage: {{withClient}} of {{attempts}} attempts with client telemetry ({{attemptCoverage}}); turns with tokens {{tokenCoverage}}, with cost {{costCoverage}}; origins: {{origins}}
analysis.group: {{key}}: {{attempts}} attempts, {{rejections}} rejections, {{demands}} approved, time {{time}}, real cost {{cost}}, client telemetry {{coverage}}
analysis.approximate: The percentiles of more than one aggregate row are approximate: p50 is the mean weighted by the counts, p95 is the greatest p95.
analysis.noTelemetry: This data folder has no telemetry base (telemetry.enabled is off), so there are no aggregates.
analysis.noToken: The api-token file is missing or cannot be read, so the daemon cannot be asked for the analysis.
analysis.badRequest: The daemon refused the period or the comparison asked for.
analysis.failedOnline: The daemon could not give the analysis (HTTP {{status}}).

chat.noDaemon: No daemon is running on this data directory (or it is not reachable). Start it with "ot daemon".
chat.opened: Chat open on scenario {{scenarioId}}. Type a message and press Enter.

generatedReply.none: System: the Director ended the turn without a reply.
generatedReply.tools: System: the Director ended the turn without a reply. Tools called: {{tools}}.{{play}}

shellEnded.timeout: Command stopped after {{seconds}} s (time limit); its processes were ended.

shellCut.tail: ... only the last {{shown}} of {{total}} lines are shown; the whole output is in the log.
shellCut.head: ... only the first {{shown}} of {{total}} lines are shown; the whole output is in the log.

chat.shellAskedInput: The command asked for input, but a ! command has no keyboard: it got the end of the input and ended.
chat.shellContextAsked: The Director was not told yet: a question waits for your answer.
chat.waitingFor_budget: waiting for the spending cap of {{profiles}}
chat.waitingFor_no_slot: waiting for a free slot on {{profiles}}
chat.menu:
Play {{playId}} needs you: {{reason}}
Type one of: {{options}} (after redefine_need, the new need; after the others, an optional reason).
chat.question: The Director asks: {{question}}
chat.badOption: That is not one of the options. Type one of: {{options}}.
chat.askWithdrawn: The question was answered somewhere else, so it was taken back.
chat.reconnecting: The connection to the daemon dropped ({{message}}). Trying again in {{seconds}} s.
chat.connectionLost: The connection to the daemon was lost: {{message}}
chat.leftPending: Something still waits for your answer. It stays in the daemon: run "ot chat" again to answer it.
chat.attached: Attached as {{id}}: {{name}} ({{mime}}, {{size}} bytes). It goes with your next message.
chat.ideaUsage: Usage: /idea [--area <area>] <text> | /idea list | /idea drain | /idea discard <id> <reason> | /idea defer <id> <reason> | /idea requeue <id>
chat.ideaHeld:
The idea queue stopped: {{what}} ({{reason}}).
  It stays stopped until you type /idea drain, /idea requeue <id> or add a new idea.
chat.ideaHeldWhat_author_failed: the Author could not group the ideas
chat.ideaHeldWhat_author_left_all_out: the Author left every idea out of the group
chat.ideaHeldWhat_play_not_opened: the play of the group did not open
chat.ideaHeldWhat_play_ended: the play of the group ended without delivering (play {{playId}})
chat.ideaGroupOptions: Type: approve | edit <new need> | keep <ids in order> | refuse [reason].
chat.ideaGroupBad: That is not one of the options. Type: approve, edit <new need>, keep <ids> or refuse [reason].

system.handoff: System: attempt {{attemptId}} passed the baton from {{from}} to {{to}} ({{cause}}); the work goes on from the saved state.
system.selectionWait: System: the {{role}} waits for an Executor that is not of the same {{what}} as the work ({{crossCheck}}); nothing else is available: {{on}}. It goes on by itself when one is.
system.resetWait: System: attempt {{attemptId}} waits for {{what}} of {{executor}} to come back, until {{until}}; it resumes the same conversation by itself.
system.resetWaitNoDate: System: attempt {{attemptId}} waits for {{what}} of {{executor}} to come back; it resumes the same conversation by itself.

directorFailover.switched: System: the Director's session of {{from}} failed ({{cause}}); a new session opened with {{to}}, with the state summary, and the prompt in progress went back to the queue.
directorFailover.waiting: System: the Director's session of {{from}} failed ({{cause}}) and no Executor is available; the queue waits and the Director goes on by itself when one is free{{until}}.
directorFailover.unavailable: System: the Director's session of {{from}} failed ({{cause}}) and no other Executor can take it; the queue is held until the next prompt tries again.

directorSwitch.live: System: the Director now runs {{what}} ({{source}}), changed in the session that was open{{waited}}.
directorSwitch.new_session: System: the Director moved from {{from}} to {{what}} ({{source}}): a new session opened, and its first prompt carries the role and the state summary{{waited}}.
directorSwitch.baton: System: the Director went on with {{what}} ({{source}}) in a new session, because the client does not let the open one change it; the first prompt carries the role and the state summary{{waited}}.
directorSwitch.stored: System: the Director will use {{what}} ({{source}}) the next time its session opens{{waited}}.
directorSwitch.unchanged: System: the Director already ran {{what}} ({{source}}); nothing changed{{waited}}.

recovery.title: System: the daemon restarted and reconciled this scenario.

directives.daemonRunning: The daemon is running on this data directory. Stop it to change orders here, or ask the Director to propose the change.

profile.daemonRunning: The daemon is running on this data directory. Stop it before changing profiles (the live control of a running daemon is not built yet).
profile.keyEnvEmpty: The environment variable {{name}} is empty or not set; no key to store.
profile.keyStdinEmpty: The standard input has no key on its first line.
profile.needsNotice: Another subscription account of {{provider}} is already registered ({{existing}}). OTheater does not check whether the terms of the provider allow more than one subscription account: read them before going on. Nothing was made. To register this profile anyway, run the command again with --accept-notice.
profile.noticeAccepted: Notice accepted and recorded: another subscription account of {{provider}} exists ({{existing}}).
profile.addedKey: The key is in the vault ({{backend}}); it is given only to the processes of this profile.
profile.addedLogin: Login: {{state}}. If it is not logged in, log in with the client itself, using this profile's folder.
profile.loginSkipped: Login skipped. To log in later: ot profile exec {{id}} login
profile.loginStarting: Logging in to {{id}} with the client itself (ot profile exec {{id}} login)...
profile.loginNotStarted: Login not started (profiles.add.login is auto, but there is no terminal here). To log in: {{command}}
profile.loginFailed: The login of {{id}} did not finish (exit code {{code}}). The profile stays registered; to try again: ot profile exec {{id}} login
profile.drained_finished: Profile {{id}} is draining: no new session; nothing was running.
profile.drained_handoff: Profile {{id}} is draining: no new session; {{sessions}} session(s) went back to the queue.
profile.drained_forced: Profile {{id}} is draining: no new session; {{sessions}} session(s) were stopped.
profile.drained_still_running: Profile {{id}} is draining: no new session; {{sessions}} session(s) are still running.
profile.dir_backup: Its folder was moved to the backup folder (profiles.drain.removed_dir: keep_backup).
profile.secretDeleted: The key was removed from the vault.
profile.execRemoved: Profile {{id}} was removed; its client cannot run in it.
profile.execNoClient: There is no adapter for the client {{client}} here (not found in PATH, or not a known client).
profile.execNoProfileCli: The adapter of {{client}} cannot run its CLI inside a profile.
profile.execDraining: Profile {{id}} is draining: the daemon gives it no new work, but this command runs.
profile.shimsConflict: No command {{name}}: another program already has that name in PATH ({{at}}). Set profiles.shims.prefix to use other names.
profile.shimsNotOnPath: The folder of the commands is not in PATH: {{bin}}. "ot profile shims path" says how to put it there.
profile.shimsFailed: The profile is done, but its command could not be written ({{reason}}); "ot profile shims sync" tries again.
profile.shimsOff: profiles.shims.mode is "off": there are no commands by profile.
profile.shimsNoLauncher: Could not tell where ot runs from, so the commands cannot call it.
profile.shimsSynced: Commands in {{bin}}: {{written}} written, {{kept}} already right, {{removed}} removed.
profile.shimsOnPath: The folder of the commands is in PATH: {{bin}}
profile.shimsOffPath: The folder of the commands is not in PATH: {{bin}}
profile.shimsWindowsByHand: On Windows, ot does not change PATH; put the folder there by hand (see "ot profile shims path").
profile.shimsWindowsHow: To put it in PATH: Settings > System > About > Advanced system settings > Environment Variables, then add {{bin}} to the Path of your user. Open a new terminal afterwards.
profile.shimsHowNoShell:
Add this line to the rc file of your shell (or say the shell with --shell), then open a new terminal:
  {{line}}
profile.shimsNeedYes: This writes in {{file}}. Run it in a terminal to answer the question, or add --yes.
profile.shimsRc_unchanged: {{file}} already has the block; nothing changed.
profile.shimsRc_removed: Removed the block from {{file}}. A terminal that is open keeps the folder in PATH until it closes.
profile.shimsRc_absent: {{file}} has no block of ot; nothing changed.
profile.shimsReload: Open a new terminal, or run in this one: {{reload}}

executor.daemonRunning: The daemon is running on this data directory. Stop it before changing Executors (the live control of a running daemon is not built yet).
executor.noModels: The catalog of {{profile}} lists no model.
executor.draft: Fields from the catalog: model {{model}}; name {{id}}; effort {{effort}} (the model accepts: {{efforts}}); provider {{provider}}; context {{context}}; reasoning {{reasoning}}; tool calls {{tools}}.
executor.needsInput: Missing: {{fields}}. Nothing was written; give it and run the command again.
executor.dryRun: Nothing was written (--dry-run). Executor {{id}} would be registered (provider {{provider}}).
executor.local_created: profiles.{{profile}}.local written: this model runs on this machine.
executor.cost: Price in the catalog (USD per million tokens): input {{input}}, output {{output}}. It is not stored here.
executor.placed_list: Put in the list of the role {{role}} (position {{position}}).
executor.placed_preset: The preset of the role {{role}} names it: it is in the role with no change to the file.
executor.askRoles: executors.on_register is "ask": it was written only in executors. To put it in a role run again with --role <role>[:<position>]; roles: {{roles}}.
executor.removedFromRoles: Taken out of the lists of the roles: {{roles}}.
executor.rolesEmptied: These lists became empty and were taken out (the role goes back to its preset): {{roles}}.

plugin.installedHint: It is off in every project. See what it asks for and turn it on with: ot plugin enable {{id}} --project <project>
plugin.needsApproval: The manifest of {{id}} changed: it stays off in {{projects}} until "ot plugin enable {{id}} --project <project>" approves it again.
plugin.alreadyOn: Plugin {{id}} is already on in project {{project}} (the manifest is the one approved).
plugin.manifestChanged: The manifest of {{id}} is not the one approved for project {{project}}. Review what it asks for now:
plugin.declined: Plugin {{id}} was not turned on in project {{project}}.
plugin.needsYes: There is no terminal to ask in: add --yes to approve plugin {{id}} after reading what it asks for.
plugin.alreadyOff: Plugin {{id}} was not on in project {{project}}.
plugin.secretPrompt: Value of the secret (it is not shown):
plugin.secretEmpty: No value was given: nothing was stored.
plugin.secretNotDeclared: Plugin {{id}} does not declare the secret {{name}}. It declares: {{declared}}.
plugin.secretDaemonRunning: The vault is an encrypted file that belongs to one process, and the daemon is running: stop it, or use the keyring vault (adapters.vault: keyring).
plugin.secretVaultLocked: The vault is locked: nothing was stored.
plugin.secretStored: Stored secret {{name}} of plugin {{id}}, for every project. A running server reads it the next time it starts.
plugin.secretStoredProject: Stored secret {{name}} of plugin {{id}}, for project {{project}}. A running server reads it the next time it starts.

activation.title: Plugin {{id}} {{version}} asks for:
activation.approval: ; every call needs the Producer's approval
activation.secrets: Secrets (the values stay in the vault): {{list}}
activation.panel: Panel: {{count}} block(s), drawn by the interface from data

error.plugin_unavailable: The plugin server is not available right now.
error.plugin_timeout: The plugin server did not answer in time.
error.plugin_failed: The plugin server failed to answer.
error.tool_unavailable: The plugin server does not offer the tool of this block.
error.tool_error: The plugin answered with an error.
error.invalid_result: The plugin answered data this block cannot draw.
error.not_readable: This block reads from a tool that is not read-only, so it is not called.

hint.detect: Confirm which accounts take part. Only their state is read: the content of a key or a login is never read.
hint.account: Choose the registered account to bring into the roles.
hint.preset: Choose the preset: it gives the list of Executors of each role.
hint.executors: Register the Executors by API and give the spending cap of each API account (empty is valid).
hint.review: This is what will be written. Nothing is in config.yaml until you confirm.

note.catalog_unavailable: The model catalog of the account could not be read: its models are not proposed.
note.effort_not_accepted: The model does not accept the effort the preset names: it is left out.
note.legacy_executors: orchestration.executor and orchestration.roles are the old format: the lists written here take their place.
note.lists_replaced: The list of the role in the file is replaced by the list of the preset.
note.budget_suggested: API account with no cap: the suggested cap (setup.suggested_budget) is proposed.
note.no_accounts: No account takes part: the lists of the roles stay empty until one is added.
note.no_account: The preset names a model that no account of this machine has: it is left out.
note.not_registered: The list names an Executor that is not registered.
note.invalid_executor: The list has an Executor that is invalid.
note.profile_not_allowed: The Executor is left out: its account is not in roles.allowed_profiles.
note.below_minimum: The Executor is below the minimum of the role.
note.empty_list: No Executor is left in the list of the role.

setup.confirmed: Setup confirmed: {{executors}} Executor(s) registered, {{written}} key(s) written to config.yaml.

service.unsupported: There is no logon service for this system ({{platform}}).
service.noEntry: Cannot tell which program the service should run: the entry of "ot" is unknown.
service.note_restart_always_is_on_failure: On this system the service cannot restart the daemon after a clean exit: service.restart: always works as on_failure.
service.note_unchanged: The definition of the service was already the same: it was left as it was.
service.note_no_restart_when_manual: With service.autostart: manual this system has no restart rule for the daemon.
service.autostartLogon: The daemon starts at every logon of this user.
service.autostartManual: The daemon does not start at logon (service.autostart: manual). "ot service start" or "ot tui" starts it.
service.lingerNote: The service runs only while you are logged in. To keep the daemon after you log out, run "loginctl enable-linger" yourself: OTheater does not do it.
service.started: The daemon was started by the service.
service.startedNow: The daemon was started by the service.
service.startFailed: The service is installed, but the daemon could not be started now: {{detail}}
service.uninstalled: Service removed. The data of OTheater was not touched.
service.wasNotInstalled: The service was not installed. Nothing to remove.
service.forcedStop: The daemon did not stop on its own in time; its process ({{pid}}) was ended.
service.stillRunning: The daemon (pid {{pid}}) is still running after the stop. End that process and try again.
service.stillRunningNoPid: A daemon still holds the data folder after the stop, and its pid is not known. End it and try again.
service.statusNotInstalled: Service: not installed ({{location}}). "ot service install" installs it.
service.statusActiveFromDaemon: Running: {{value}} (read from the daemon of this data folder: the service manager does not tell).
service.statusDaemonNoApi: Daemon: running, but its API is not published yet (it is starting or waiting for the master password).
service.noSession: The service manager of the system cannot be reached from this session (no user session, or no user bus). Log in to a user session and try again.
service.notInstalled: The service is not installed. Run "ot service install".
service.unavailable: The service manager of the system is not available: {{detail}}

tui.startFailed_no_command: Could not start the daemon: the entry of "ot" is unknown ({{detail}}). The interface opens without it.
tui.startFailed_spawn_failed: Could not start the daemon: {{detail}}. The interface opens without it.
tui.startFailed_timeout: The daemon did not publish its API in {{detail}}. The interface opens without it; "ot daemon" shows why in a terminal.
tui.serviceFallback: The service could not start the daemon ({{detail}}); a daemon of your own was started instead.

uninstall.refused_root: Refusing to delete {{dir}}: it is the root of a drive.
uninstall.refused_home: Refusing to delete {{dir}}: it is, or holds, your home folder.
uninstall.refused_not_data: Refusing to delete {{dir}}: it does not look like an OTheater data folder (no config.yaml, store.sqlite or daemon-id).
uninstall.refused_running: Refusing to delete {{dir}}: a daemon is running on it. Stop it ("ot service stop") and try again.
uninstall.needYes: --purge-data deletes the data and asks first; with no terminal, add --yes.
uninstall.confirmPurge: This deletes ALL the OTheater data in {{dir}} (configuration, store, backups, logs, profiles and worktrees). It cannot be undone. The keyring is not touched. Continue?
uninstall.keptData: The data was kept in {{dir}} ("ot uninstall --purge-data" deletes it).

init.serviceAlready: The service is already installed ({{location}}). It is not written again.
init.daemonStarted_service: The daemon was started by the service (API at {{url}}).
init.daemonStarted_child: The daemon was started as a process of your own (API at {{url}}).
init.daemonFailed_spawn_failed: the daemon could not be started: {{detail}}.
init.daemonFailed_timeout: the daemon did not publish its API in {{detail}}; "ot daemon" shows why in a terminal.
init.stepClients: Step {{step}} of {{total}}: the commands of the Executors (the clients are only looked for; the ACP adapters are installed by OTheater, as clients.adapters.install says).
init.someMissing: {{count}} command(s) missing. OTheater never installs a client (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode): run the npm commands above yourself, then "ot init" again if you want to see this list once more. A client you do not use can be left out. An ACP adapter is installed with "ot adapters install".
init.stepTui: Step {{step}} of {{total}}: the terminal interface (it opens the setup assistant when there is no configuration yet).
init.setupNever: ui.setup.open is "never": the interface will not open the assistant by itself. Open it from the Settings tab.
init.noTerminal: There is no terminal here, so the interface was not opened. "ot tui" opens it.
init.addAccountHint: To add an account and log in to it: ot profile add <client> <name> --login (clients: claude-code, codex, opencode).
init.doneNoTui: Done (--no-tui). "ot tui" opens the terminal interface.
init.repeat: What was done before stays. To repeat only this step, run: {{command}}
init.adapterWaitsClient: {{name}}: not installed yet; it comes with {{client}} (the daemon installs it when {{client}} is in PATH).
init.adapterOff: {{name}}: not installed and clients.adapters.install is off. Install it yourself and set clients.{{id}}.adapter to "path".
init.adapterAsk: Install {{name}} from {{registry}} into the data folder of OTheater (no sudo, nothing in PATH changes)?
init.adapterRetry: The install of {{name}} failed. "ot adapters install" tries again.

adapters.mode: Managed ACP adapters: clients.adapters.install is {{install}}; registry {{registry}}.
adapters.statusNotInstalled: not installed by OTheater. "ot adapters install" installs it.
adapters.statusOfficialMissing: official client {{command}}: not in PATH (OTheater never installs it).
adapters.configProblem: The configuration could not be read ({{reason}}); the defaults are used.
adapters.installOff: clients.adapters.install is off: nothing is installed. Set it to auto, ask or command to use "ot adapters install".
adapters.installing: Installing {{adapter}} {{version}} from {{registry}} (sha512 checked, no sudo, nothing in PATH changes)...
adapters.noOfficial: Note: {{command}}, the official client the adapter drives, is not in PATH. OTheater never installs it; the adapter works once you install {{command}}.
adapters.restartHint: A running daemon starts the installed adapter in its next session; a client that was left off turns on when the daemon restarts.

vault.status: The vault of the secrets (adapters.vault) is {{mode}}. The choices: {{modes}}.
vault.configProblem: The configuration could not be read ({{reason}}).
vault.unchanged: The vault of the secrets is already {{mode}}; nothing changed.
vault.changed: The vault of the secrets is now {{mode}} (it was {{before}}), in {{path}}. Secrets saved before stay in the vault they were saved in.
vault.restartHint: A running daemon uses the new vault when it restarts.
